evidence: Structural integrity and dielectric thickness in devices were investigated using transmission electron microscopy (TEM), electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS), and energy dispersive x-ray spectroscopy (EDXS). Surface topography by atomic force microscopy revealed a root mean square roughness. High frequency C-V characteristics were measured on MOSCAPs. Capacitance-voltage (C-V) measurements revealed postdielectric deposition anneal reduced hysteresis.
